# `browser-tab operations`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab operations [--id <operationId>] [--limit <n>]`

Read the daemon's operation journal (apply/copy/cut executions)

## Flags

### `--id <operationId>`

Fetch one operation record

### `--limit <n>`

How many recent operations to list (default 20)
